    if not ctx.check_explicit_conditions(actor, target, cfg): return DENIED

    destination = resolve_valid_destination(target_or_point)
    if not permitted_by_spatial_rules(actor,destination): return DENIED

    move_actor_atomically(actor,safe_destination)

    ctx.emit_effect_event(ability_id)
